pairs.subject: chat-transcript
pairs.evidence: features/graph/components/GraphStage.tsx:4 The context is a 2D canvas node/edge graph explorer with no conversational turns, no machine-authored streamed messages and no composer; I searched features/graph/ for transcript, composer, assistant and streaming and found no hits, so the precondition for a chat transcript (a document read while a machine writes it turn by turn) does not hold.

techniques.evidence: features/graph/components/NodeSearch.tsx:4 The only text input is a node-search combobox. It is not a prompt composer, and there are no turns to queue against.
features/graph/components/NodeInspector.tsx:4 Structured detail is a node inspector panel over the graph. There is no turn sequence for tool or approval rows to sit inside.
features/graph/viewCull.ts:2 The viewport is a pan/zoom canvas cull, which canvas-graph governs. There is no growing transcript to pin or to open at the latest turn.
features/graph/components/GraphStage.tsx:4 The entities here are kg nodes and edges, not conversational turns.
